name: multiselect
title: Multiselect
description: A multi-choice field for picking several values from a searchable list. Chosen items appear as small chips with x buttons inside the input, and an open dropdown lists the remaining choices with a dimmed disabled one.
use: A field needs several values from a known list, with chips showing what is already chosen.
avoid: Chips stay inside the field, so many picks wrap and push the open dropdown further down.
a11y: Remove and clear buttons carry labels and focus rings show, but the chips and open list have no single announced multi-select name. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded input under a bold label and above a tiny hint, holding small outlined chips with x buttons, a text caret and a clear-all x at the right. An open bordered dropdown beneath lists framework names in light grey, one of them dimmed.
behaves: Focusing the box opens the dropdown; typing filters the list in place, and clicking a name turns it into a removable chip and drops it from the list. A chip's x or Backspace removes it, and the clear-all x empties the field.
customise: Pass an options array, a controlled value and an onChange; flags cover search, pick limits, creatable entries and the clear button, while field and chip classes take styling.
weight: light: A filtered option list and chips; nothing runs while the field is closed.
demo: Framework names Next.js, Astro, React, Remix, SvelteKit, Nuxt.js, Vite, Angular and Gatsby.
issues: The dropdown overlaps the helper line that sits directly under the field
The disabled Angular row is dimmed but otherwise looks the same as a live row
No frame shows the 'No results found' empty state
polishWhy: Clear chip workflow, but the dropdown covers the helper line and the rows are tightly packed.
